uutiset.t: Prosecutors seek 25-year prison term for 'poison seller' Kenneth Law
uutiset.s: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, will be sentenced at a later date.

uutiset.t: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
uutiset.s: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

uutiset.t: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
uutiset.s: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

uutiset.t: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
uutiset.s: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

uutiset.t: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
uutiset.s: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

uutiset.t: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
uutiset.s: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

uutiset.t: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
uutiset.s: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.

uutiset.t: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
uutiset.s: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.

uutiset.t: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
uutiset.s: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

uutiset.t: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
uutiset.s: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

uutiset.t: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
uutiset.s: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

uutiset.t: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
uutiset.s: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.

uutiset.t: 'It's impossible': Spain's young people on housing ahead of Sunday's election
uutiset.s: Europe correspondent Nick Beake speaks to one couple kept apart by high rents in Valencia.

uutiset.t: Inside Saudi Arabia, Houthi attacks test kingdom's image of security
uutiset.s: Despite the strikes, markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them.

uutiset.t: Met Police ruined my life, says Kenyan man wrongly convicted over attack on UK couple
uutiset.s: Evidence from a British police officer helped convict Ali Kololo over a 2011 attack in the Kenyan resort of Lamu.
